تتعايوا (form VI)
# تَتَعَايَوْا (tataʕāyaw) /ta.ta.ʕaː.jaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# تُتَعَايَوْا (tutaʕāyaw) /tu.ta.ʕaː.jaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
